headline: Bitcoin hovered just under $60,000 early Saturday after swinging between about $58,700 and $62,100 on Friday, while US stocks closed their best week since April 2025.

market.asOf: Bitcoin read from CoinDesk's price page at 10:55pm ET Fri 27 Nov (03:55 UTC; 10:55 Bangkok Sat). Ether from IT Times at 11:00 Korea time Sat (02:00 UTC). Solana and Fear & Greed from CoinMarketCap's homepage at about 03:55 UTC; solana's 24h change could not be read. Use the live prices on this page.

stories.title: Bitcoin's Friday rally fades at the US open while stocks finish their best week since April 2025
stories.summary: Bitcoin climbed to about $62,100 early on Friday, then fell to about $58,700 after Wall Street opened, even as US stocks kept rising. It is now just under $60,000, and whether its seven-week losing streak ends depends on Sunday's weekly close.
points: Bitcoin was at $59,923.74, down 2.34% over 24 hours, on CoinDesk's price page at 10:55pm ET Friday.
After touching $62,100, bitcoin fell to a local low of about $58,700 after the Wall Street open, and $228 million of positions were liquidated in the hour to 3pm UTC, per Cointelegraph.
The S&P 500 rose 1.6% on Friday for a 5.6% weekly gain, its biggest since April 2025; the Nasdaq rose 2.3% and the Dow 1.2%, per AP.
Bitcoin is down about 20% in November, its biggest monthly loss since June, per CoinDesk.
Galaxy withdrew its call that bitcoin bottomed in June and said a daily close below $58,525 would break a standing low, per The Block.

stories.title: US bitcoin funds set a record for monthly withdrawals, and Strategy leaves MSCI's indexes after Monday's close
stories.summary: Money pulled from US spot bitcoin funds in November is already a record, and Friday's figures had not been published yet. MSCI drops bitcoin treasury company Strategy from its indexes after Monday's close, which could prompt funds that track those indexes to sell its shares.
points: November outflows reached about $5.39 billion per Farside data, above the previous record of $4.51 billion set in June, per The Library.
Spot bitcoin funds had seven straight days of outflows totalling $3.05 billion from 17 to 25 Nov, including $453 million on 25 Nov; Friday's flows were not yet available, per Bitcoin Sistemi.
MSCI-linked funds hold about 13 million Strategy shares, 3.1% of its basic shares, and JPMorgan estimated about $2.8 billion of selling, per Cointelegraph.

stories.title: Binance's hack recovery is done; the fight over frozen funds goes to an Abu Dhabi court on Tuesday
stories.summary: Binance says its withdrawal recovery from the 29 October hack is complete, with a few networks paused for maintenance. A court in Abu Dhabi holds a hearing on 1 December on whether 18 firms must keep hack-linked tokens frozen.
points: Binance said its withdrawal recovery work is completed and withdrawals for a small number of networks are temporarily paused for maintenance or upgrades; about $6.3 billion was affected, per CoinDesk.

An order from the ADGM court in Abu Dhabi requires 18 firms, including Circle and World Liberty Financial, to keep hack-linked tokens frozen, and a 1 Dec hearing will consider whether that continues, per The Defiant citing Reuters.
In a separate report, Tether sought reissuance fees of up to 20% from some crypto hack victims before returning USDT it froze, and says it has reissued $1.2 billion, per Blockhead.

briefs.title: Ethereum schedules its next upgrade test
briefs.summary: Developers set the Glamsterdam upgrade to activate on the Hoodi test network on 15 Dec 2026 at 19:12 UTC, per The Block. No main-network date is set.

briefs.title: About $6.8 billion of bitcoin options expired Friday
briefs.summary: About 112,323 BTC of Deribit options expired at 08:00 UTC on 27 Nov with a put/call ratio of 0.94, per CryptoTicker.

briefs.title: World Liberty's token slides
briefs.summary: WLFI was at $0.036, down 14.89% in 24 hours, on Friday afternoon, per TokenPost. No cause was confirmed.

briefs.title: KuCoin delists Monero on Monday
briefs.summary: KuCoin removes its XMR spot pairs at 08:00 UTC on 30 Nov; withdrawals stay open until 31 Dec, per KuCoin.

briefs.title: Spain lets its financial watchdog freeze crypto accounts
briefs.summary: A new decree lets Spain's financial intelligence unit freeze crypto accounts for up to 5 business days without a court order, from 25 Jan 2027, per Cointelegraph.
